01 — On the work

Canvas, paper,
and sometimes a human face.
The imagination stays the same.

Sandra works in several techniques side by side: acrylic, watercolor, neurographics and artistic makeup. The same subjects keep returning: faces, forests, the sea, horses and characters from fairy tales.

05 — Workshops

Workshops
with Sandra.

Sandra teaches children and adults, runs NeuroGraphica and painting workshops, and leads groups in creative self-exploration. This is what it looks like from the inside.

01

Neurographics

You draw lines without planning, round off the corners and color them in. It is far more calming than it sounds.

02

Color and material

Acrylic, watercolor, pastel and markers. No experience needed.

03

Children and adults

Individual lessons, group workshops and creative laboratories for children and adults.

Original methods and creative self-exploration

Sandra is currently developing her own method of group creative self-exploration, combining movement, breathing, gesture, artistic improvisation, NeuroGraphica, and philosophical reflection.

She is a NeuroGraphica instructor and supervisor, an aesthetic coach, and a bodywork practitioner.

Book a session or workshop

An interactive guide: try the neurographics method yourself, step by step, right in the browser. A few minutes, one line and a blank sheet.

Try it now

06 — Nice to meet you

Sandra
Leifer.

Sandra Leifer is a professional artist with formal academic training in fine art and more than 20 years of experience teaching visual arts.

Born in Yaroslavl, she received her professional art education there. She studied at Art School No. 1 and Yaroslavl Art College and was a private student of her father, the artist Boris Leifer. She has lived and worked in Israel since 2022.

Painting
Acrylic, watercolor and pastel
Line
Neurographics and drawing
Body
Theater makeup and body art
Words
Illustrated fairy tales for children
Bodywork
Bodywork practitioner
Coaching
Aesthetic coach

Sandra holds the title of Arts Professional of Israel and is a member of the Union of Professional Artists of Israel and the UNESCO Artists’ Union. She has received international awards in creative makeup and artistic makeup.

Read the full biography

Achievements

Exhibitions and achievements

Sandra Leifer has participated in solo and group art exhibitions in Israel and Moscow.

  • In September 2026, her solo exhibition “A Fairy Tale Born from a Blot” took place in Tel Aviv. It explored intuitive art, imagination, and the human capacity to discover artistic images in unexpected forms.
  • Three group exhibitions at the Municipal Gallery in Afula, Israel.
  • One group art exhibition in Bat Yam, Israel.
  • A group exhibition of visionary artists in Moscow.
  • In 2025 and 2026, her work in creative makeup, artistic makeup, and body art won first prizes at international competitions in Israel.

Children Artists

Sandra Leifer is the creator of the international project “Children Artists,” dedicated to art education and the development and support of children’s creativity. Representatives of 19 countries have taken part in the project.
